facts: GLA Site Allocations polygons are explicitly described as indicative and borough confirmation is requested
London Planning Local Plan Data publishes borough-specific polygon packages and web services
Borough-specific target-layer feature geometry is therefore the preferred route to borough-confirmed binding
A complete GLA layer envelope can prove exclusion from that published layer when the point lies outside it
A GLA envelope exclusion is kept separate from borough-confirmed site-allocation status
Planning Data development-plan documents are MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
Planning Data document taxonomy is useful for discovery but is not parcel geometry
SHLAA is explicitly not a site allocations exercise and remains evidence-base context
Source availability, plan name, document type and service extent are never promoted as exact membership
Business scoring remains gated on authoritative feature-level binding with provenance
